es: Presentar una contraoferta razonada con condiciones, una concesión y una pregunta de cierre.

vocabulary.es: que se adapta, con margen para ceder

teaching.en: I could accept eight hundred dollars, provided that you include breakfast.
teaching.es: Podría aceptar ochocientos dólares, siempre que incluya el desayuno.
teaching.explanationEs: I could accept + oferta, provided that + condición: contraoferta con condición.
segments: I could accept eight hundred dollars,
teaching.audioText: I could accept eight hundred dollars, provided that you include breakfast.

teaching.en: We are willing to pay the deposit in two parts, as long as you agree.
teaching.es: Estamos dispuestos a pagar el depósito en dos partes, siempre que estés de acuerdo.
teaching.explanationEs: Willing to + verbo muestra flexibilidad; as long as añade una condición.
segments: We are willing to pay the deposit in
two parts, as long as you agree.
teaching.audioText: We are willing to pay the deposit in two parts, as long as you agree.

teaching.en: In return, we can be flexible about the check-in time.
teaching.es: A cambio, podemos ser flexibles con la hora de entrada.
teaching.explanationEs: In return introduce lo que ofreces a cambio: la concesión.
teaching.audioText: In return, we can be flexible about the check-in time.

teaching.en: Would that arrangement work for you?
teaching.explanationEs: Pregunta de cierre: devuelve la decisión a la otra persona.
teaching.audioText: Would that arrangement work for you?

teaching.en: That is our counteroffer; we hope we can meet you halfway.
teaching.es: Esa es nuestra contraoferta; esperamos encontrar un punto medio.
teaching.explanationEs: Meet halfway significa que cada parte cede un poco.
segments: That is our counteroffer; we hope
teaching.audioText: That is our counteroffer; we hope we can meet you halfway.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase contrapropone con una condición clara?

choices.text: Seven hundred or nothing; I will not discuss it.
I accept seven hundred dollars because I like the house.
I could accept seven hundred dollars, provided that you include the parking.

feedback.es: Solo la frase con provided that une una cantidad propia con una condición clara.

prompt.es: Completa: «A cambio, podemos ser flexibles con las fechas.»

feedback.es: In return introduce lo que ofreces a cambio.

hint.es: Es la expresión de la clase que introduce lo que ofreces a cambio.

origin.text: In ___, we can be flexible about the dates.

feedback.es: La pregunta de cierre empieza con would; that arrangement es el sujeto.

prompt.es: Completa tres piezas de una contraoferta.

feedback.es: Accept presenta la oferta, willing to muestra flexibilidad y meet you halfway busca un punto medio.

prompt.es: Contraofertar por el sofá: propón un precio con una condición.

answer.text: I could accept a hundred and twenty, provided you pick it up.
accepted: I could accept a hundred and twenty, provided you pick it up.
I could accept a hundred and twenty if you pick it up.
I can offer a hundred and twenty, provided you pick it up.
I could accept a hundred and twenty dollars, provided that you pick it up.
I could accept one hundred and twenty dollars as long as you pick it up.
I could accept 120 dollars, provided you pick it up.

origin.text: Un vecino ofrece 100 dólares por tu sofá y tú pides 140. Propón 120 dólares con la condición de que venga a recogerlo.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ofrece el grupo a cambio.

choices.text: To go home on Sunday morning.

feedback.es: In return, we will leave on Sunday morning: la concesión es marcharse el domingo por la mañana.

origin.audio: We cannot pay a thousand dollars, but we could pay eight hundred and fifty, provided that you include the cleaning. In return, we will leave on Sunday morning.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta es una contraoferta con concesión al precio del texto?

choices.text: Four hundred and fifty, no more.
I could pay four hundred and fifty, and in return I can sign for a year.
Five hundred is fine; I accept.

feedback.es: La respuesta con in return propone un precio menor y ofrece algo a cambio; las demás rechazan o aceptan sin más.

origin.text: Owner: «The room is five hundred dollars.»

answer.text: We are willing to pay half today

feedback.es: Willing to + verbo base muestra disposición; half today dice cuánto y cuándo.

prompt.es: Escribe tu contraoferta para la casa: condiciones, concesión y pregunta final.

answer.text: Thank you for your offer. I understand that nine hundred dollars is a fair price for the weekend, but it is more than our group can afford. I could accept eight hundred dollars, provided that you include breakfast for six people. We are also willing to pay the deposit in two parts, as long as you agree. In return, we can be flexible about the check-in time: we are happy to arrive after four o'clock on Friday. We will take very good care of the house and leave it clean on Sunday morning. My friends and I have rented houses before, and we never had any problems. I hope we can meet you halfway. Would that arrangement work for you?

feedback.es: La contraoferta reconoce la oferta, pone dos condiciones, ofrece una concesión y cierra con una pregunta.

origin.text: Una casa de vacaciones cuesta 900 dólares el fin de semana para seis personas. Escribe tu contraoferta: reconoce la oferta, propón un precio con dos condiciones, ofrece una concesión y cierra con una pregunta.

prompt.es: Completa: «Siempre que limpies la casa, acepto el precio.»

feedback.es: As long as equivale a provided that: introduce la condición.

origin.text: ___ long as you clean the house, I accept the price.

feedback.es: Could we agree on that? devuelve la decisión a la otra parte; las otras frases cierran la negociación a la fuerza.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ofrece la hablante a cambio del precio más bajo.

choices.text: To pay part of the money right away.

feedback.es: In return for a lower price, ofrece pagar el depósito hoy.

origin.audio: I am willing to pay the deposit today, in return for a lower price for the weekend. Would you accept seven hundred and fifty?
